name: Nihongo Master v1.5.6 - Crash Diagnostics & Robust System Logging
changelog: v1.5.6: Added a comprehensive logging and crash diagnostic system. Captures runtime logs in ~/.local/share/nihongo-master/logs/nihongo_master.log and dumps complete system telemetry, stack traces, and subgame errors into nihongo_master_crash.log on any unexpected failure. Added --logs CLI inspector and protected arcade game loop from freeze.
